summary: TODO-002 satisfies the approved acceptance criteria. The admin switch, static URL/QR rendering, participant and pending static flows, switch-off behavior, admin read-only view, mixed SUN/static behavior, participant token-hiding requirement, and required static/browser validation are all supported by repository evidence.
warnings: Web NFC device scanning was not exercised in a real browser/device path; the shared static URL parser used by the scan handler was validated, and this limitation is recorded in the implementation/report.
The `/race` pending failure text is cleared by an existing reload behavior; validation records this as pre-existing and asserts the one-shot submission via DB evidence instead.
evidence: Reviewed mandatory rules and artifacts: `.ai/reviewer/REVIEWER.md`, request, plan, analysis, TODO-002, implementation manifest, and state.json.

Admin NFC UI implements the switch PATCH, warning, conditional static URL/QR rendering, and copy control in `src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ui.tsx:320`, `src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ui.tsx:373`, `src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ui.tsx:431`, and `src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ui.tsx:495`.
`/t/[token]` preserves SUN handling, gates static participant submission by token session `allowStaticUrl`, and routes admin devices to the read-only static view in `src/app/t/[token]/page.tsx:28`.

Participant static landing stores/submits JSON `{token}` through the shared pending flow and uses a per-mount guard in `src/app/t/[token]/participant-landing.tsx:15` and `src/app/t/[token]/participant-landing.tsx:53`.

`/race` accepts static pending payloads and Web NFC static URLs only when `/api/me` exposes `view.session.allowStaticUrl` in `src/app/race/page.tsx:94`, `src/app/race/page.tsx:113`, and `src/app/race/page.tsx:127`.
Static URL parsing rejects SUN URLs and invalid paths while lowercasing valid `/t/{10-char-token}` URLs in `src/lib/nfc.ts:36`.
Participant `/api/me` view carries only the boolean switch, with tags still narrowed to id/name/order in `src/lib/race.ts` output shown by inspection and `src/lib/types.ts:97`.

Static validation passed: `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/runtime/static/TODO-002/summary.txt:1` records `VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED`, `LINT_BASELINE=MATCH`, and `TSC_EXIT=0`; `lint-delta.txt` says there are no new lint findings.
Browser validation passed: `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/runtime/web/TODO-002/report.md:3` records the local URL/roles; lines 14-67 cover AC1-AC8; line 82 records `BROWSER_STATUS=PASSED`.
Browser script assertions were inspected and use stable selectors/text/network/DB checks without coordinates; output has 58 PASS and `BROWSER_STATUS=PASSED`.
Inspected cited screenshots for the admin QR/switch, admin static view, participant success overlay, and switch-off participant screen.
regressions_checked: TODO-001 regression check was rerun because TODO-002 touched `src/lib/db.ts` and `src/lib/types.ts`; `evidence/TODO-002/regression-api-check-static.local.out.txt` reports ALL PASS.
SUN flow regression checked by `npm run test:sun` per implementation manifest and by browser AC7 covering `/t/s?e&c` participant credit plus admin SUN panel behavior.
Switch-off sessions verified to preserve today's no-SUN-info page with 0 `/api/tag` POSTs and no `pendingTag` writes in browser report AC5.
Participant token leak regression checked in browser report AC8 and script output: `/race` HTML and `/api/me` contain none of the test tag tokens.
